title: Multi Source Flood Fill
goal: Solve Multi Source Flood Fill: Spread simultaneous BFS waves, resolve competing colors by maximum, and inspect arrival times in the grid.
strategy: Spread simultaneous BFS waves, resolve competing colors by maximum, and inspect arrival times in the grid.

phasePurposes.propose: Gather proposals without allowing pending cells to spread.

edgeCases: All starting sources enter the flood together; same-layer competing arrivals must be resolved before advancing to the next layer.

checks.condition: not (0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < m)

inputRules: Enter {"n":3,"m":3,"sources":[[0,0,1]]}, with positive dimensions, at most 100,000 cells, and at least one source.
Each source must have a unique in-bounds [row,column], and an integer color from 1 to 1,000,000.
